subject: Proposal: interim coverage and manager roll-forward for EMEA SEs
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: interim coverage and manager roll-forward for EMEA SEs

Team —

Quick heads up: Elena Morales (EMEA Sr. Manager, SE) informed me this morning she intends to step down from the manager role effective June 11 to pursue an internal IC rotation. She's excellent technically but the team stability around quota and mid-market coverage needs a short-term manager who can own performance calibrations and the June 20 customer QBRs.

Given the timing (end-of-quarter prep + two scheduled QBRs with Arcade and Avantech), I propose a temporary roll-forward: Rishi Malhotra to step in as interim manager from June 1–Aug 31. Rishi has run the mid-market pod before and can take on 1:1s, performance calibration, and QBR ownership. Vivek — asking you to confirm that Rishi's sprint-level bandwidth is compatible with this.

Neha — can People Ops run the manager transfer checklist and expedite a short-form change of manager approval? I'm attaching a one-page performance_summary and a draft transition_plan (see attachments). Key asks:
- HR approval for interim assignment and access changes (calendar ownership, 1:1s, compensation visibility)
- Approve limited scope (no promotion/comp comp changes) so we avoid triggering a formal comp review cycle
- Draft comms to team + customers (I can write a short note once we have OK)

I'll loop in external BA/SE leads as needed after we confirm.

Thanks —
Markus
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: performance_summary_may2027.pdf (pdf, 92KB); transition_plan_draft.docx (docx, 48KB)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 10:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: interim coverage and manager roll-forward for EMEA SEs

Thanks for the flag, Markus.

We can move quickly but I need two things before I can issue formal approval and update systems:
1) Full performance packet for Elena (recent 1:1 notes + last two performance reviews). The single-page summary helps but HR needs the source docs.
2) Manager transfer form filled out (I can attach the short template) that confirms dates, scope, and handover ownership.

From a policy perspective: temporary coverage for up to 90 days without comp/progression changes is standard; we just need the form and sign-offs from the business owner (Laura) and the regional head (Vivek). Also note we'll create a People Ops ticket for audit and to make the org chart change.

I started a People Ops ticket: PO-4821 (internal). Once we have the documents I can fast-track it and publish the manager change to Workday and Slack.

Neha
People Partner, Redwood Inference
